title: The Wyld at War
summary: How the Wyld fights its siblings in the modern nights.

claims.text: The Wyld can create but cannot give its creations a fixed form or place; the Weaver gives form but cannot truly create.
Mostly penned in the Umbra, the Wyld builds strength in the spirit realms and strikes at the Weaver and Wyrm with sudden, guerrilla-like attacks.
Now and then it hurls itself at the Weaver in full force, but its nature makes it hard to stay on any one task for long.
The Wyld treats its Garou allies as incidental and would no more mourn a million of them than a person mourns shed skin.

title: Wyld Thresholds
summary: Places where the Wyld breaks into the physical world.

claims.text: A Threshold is the Wyld made manifest in the physical world; Wyldling spirits treat it as holy ground and will defend it at any cost.
When a Threshold withdraws to the Umbra the land usually returns to the state it was in before, though in dire need it may break apart into a swarm of Wyldling-like spirits.
No one knows what births a Threshold; one theory blames the Wyrm's mass destruction of living things.
A Threshold forming over a caern, an Abscess, can drive out the caern totem; Garou Theurges advise close communion with the caern's spirits as the best guard.
The Black Fury caern of Miria is held up as a Wyld caern where a Threshold and the sept live side by side.
